title: Median Calculation
description: Find the median salary for each department. Use percentile_cont or a combination of ROW_NUMBER and COUNT to compute the median. Return columns: department, median_salary.
hints: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY salary) computes the median directly
Use it as a window function: PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY salary) OVER (PARTITION BY department)
SELECT DISTINCT if using window functions to avoid duplicates
